description: The Rune Knight harnesses ancient runes to fuel magical powers in combat.

features.name: Rune Magic
features.description: Learn runes to inscribe on equipment. Each rune grants a benefit. Learn 2 runes, gaining more at higher levels.

features.name: Runic Shield
features.description: Inscribe a rune on shield, gaining benefit (e.g., +2 AC, advantage vs fire).

features.name: Giant Might
features.description: Cast enlarge self on yourself using Strength modifier + Dex, becoming larger and stronger.

features.name: Rune Mastery
features.description: Learn additional runes with enhanced effects. Can have multiple runes active.
